title_en: Heshkili, a little above it all
description_en: A short drive out of Mestia, a small village and a wide view toward Laila. Bring a warm layer and leave a little room in the afternoon.
details_en: A relaxed viewpoint outing for a day when you want mountain air without a long hike. Spend time around Heshkili, take a short walk if the ground suits you, then return to Mestia. We plan around the view and the village; use of the swing and any café stop depend on the people running them.
itinerary_en:
Meet in Mestia and drive toward Heshkili after checking the access road.
Allow about an hour at the village and viewpoint for a short walk, photographs and a break.
Return to Mestia with time in hand. Allow 2–3 hours overall; agree the exact pickup and return time with the driver.
inclusions_en: The proposed outing covers return transport from Mestia and time at Heshkili. The quote confirms the vehicle, pickup, driver and whether a separate guide joins you.
exclusions_en: Food, tea, drinks, paid activities and any admission unless listed in the quote. Swing access, café opening and clear views are not promised.
requirements_en: Shoes with grip, a warm layer and rain protection. Tell us about mobility needs, child-seat needs or difficulty boarding a vehicle so the stops can be planned sensibly.
season_en: June–September is the planning window. May and October need a fresh check of the road and ground conditions; winter is a separate arrangement.
difficulty: Short optional walks; uneven village ground
meeting_point_en: Your agreed pickup point in Mestia; confirmed with the quote.
weather_en: If cloud hides the view, move the outing to a clearer part of the day if possible. Snow, ice, heavy rain or an unsafe road mean a change of plan. A Mestia museum visit can be discussed instead, with opening and any extra cost checked first.
walking_en: Short optional walks near the vehicle stops. The driver confirms the closest safe stopping place; this is not a step-free access promise.
driving_en: Return drive between Mestia and Heshkili. The 2–3 hour allowance includes the visit and a road-delay buffer, not just driving.
operator_notes: Original short-outing proposal. GNTA locates Heshkili near Mestia and identifies the Laila view; TravelMestia demonstrates demand for a short vehicle outing. June–September and the 2–3 hour allowance are conservative planning choices, not official operating dates. Check vehicle access, safe stopping and any café or swing arrangements locally. Do not adopt a competitor's all-ages suitability, year-round access, free swing use, tea service, departure schedule or passenger limit.

description_en: Forest trail, tower villages and the high pools of Koruldi. Unpack once in Mestia and head out in a different direction each morning.
details_en: Three separate day trips with Mestia as your base: a Chalaadi viewpoint walk, a day in Ushguli and a Koruldi 4×4 outing. There is one main route each day, with room to swap the order for the weather. Arrive the day before and plan your onward journey for the day after; that normally means four nights in Mestia. Accommodation and travel to the region are agreed separately.
itinerary_en:
Before day 1 — arrive in Mestia, settle in and agree the next morning's pickup.
Day 1 — Chalaadi: drive to the bridge trailhead, walk through forest to a safe glacier viewpoint and return. Allow 4–5 hours, leaving the rest of the day free. No walking on or beneath the ice.
Day 2 — Ushguli: a village day through the Enguri valley, with Chazhashi, the Lamaria area and a proper lunch break. Allow 7–8 hours including the return drive.
Day 3 — Koruldi by 4×4: allow 3–4 hours for the rough-road return outing and short walks by the lakes when conditions allow. Spend the remaining time in Mestia.
After day 3 — keep your onward transfer for the following day. The order and turnaround points remain flexible.
inclusions_en: Proposed scope: three outings from Mestia, return road transport for each and a walking guide for Chalaadi. The written quote confirms drivers, vehicles, guiding on the other days, languages and pickup details.
exclusions_en: Accommodation, travel to and from Mestia, meals, drinks, entry tickets and personal walking equipment unless listed in the quote. A lunch break is time to eat, not an included meal. No full Shkhara hike or Koruldi hike from town is included.
requirements_en: Comfort with a 2–3 hour walk over uneven ground and bumpy mountain drives. Bring walking footwear, warm layers, waterproofs, water and a day bag. Tell us about walking limits, child seats and motion sickness before agreeing the plan.
season_en: July–September is the core window for the full programme. June and October require a revised plan if snow or road conditions rule out Koruldi.
duration: 3 days in Mestia; travel days extra
difficulty: Moderate Chalaadi walk; village walks and rough-road drives
meeting_point_en: An agreed Mestia pickup point each morning. Arrive before the programme begins; this is not a departure from Kutaisi or Tbilisi.
weather_en: Use the clearest suitable day for Koruldi and swap the order when useful. Chalaadi is cancelled in rain, fog or unsafe valley conditions. If a route remains unsuitable, agree a town museum-and-lanes day, a shorter outing or a revised quote. Extra days are useful but do not guarantee that every route will open.
walking_en: Day 1: approximately 6 km return and 280 m net climb from the drive-assisted Chalaadi trailhead, with the guide choosing a safe turnaround. Day 2: short village walks. Day 3: optional short walks near Koruldi; no full ascent from Mestia on foot.
driving_en: Road transport returns to Mestia each day. Chalaadi uses a trailhead transfer; Ushguli takes the largest part of a day; Koruldi uses a rough mountain track. Daily totals are planning allowances including stops. Transfers into and out of Svaneti are separate travel days.
operator_notes: Original Mestia-based package inspired by the reference operators' day-trip range and short-break format. It deliberately keeps regional transfers outside the three activity days and gives each destination its own outing. Confirm four accommodation nights if guests follow the suggested arrival/departure pattern; do not reserve rooms by assumption. Check the Chalaadi guide and trailhead, Ushguli road and local access, Koruldi vehicle/track, legal seating and each day's forecast. Programme durations follow our existing conservative route drafts. Do not copy the competitors' guaranteed departures, prices, capacity, inclusions or packed transfer-day timetable.
